# stackit_containerregistry_replication_adapters (Data Source)

Container registry replication adapters data source schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

data "stackit_containerregistry_replication_adapters" "this" {
  project_id = local.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the replication adapters are associated.

### Optional

- `region` (String) STACKIT region where the replication adapters are located. If not defined, the provider default_region is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform's internal data source ID, structured as `project_id`,`region`.
- `replication_adapters` (Attributes List) List of supported replication adapters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replication_adapters))

<a id="nestedatt--replication_adapters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replication_adapters`

Read-Only:

- `credential_type` (String) User-hint for what type of credentials are expected for the replication adapter type.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name of the provider the adapter relates to.
- `registry_type` (String) Identifies the replication adapter.
